scheme.defaultMessage: {mode, select, dark {Switch to dark mode} other {Switch to light mode}}
scheme.description: The accessible name of the color scheme toggle. `mode` is the scheme it switches to.

open.description: The accessible name of the button that opens the appearance dialog.

close.description: The accessible name of the button that closes the appearance dialog.

title.description: The title of the appearance dialog.

description.defaultMessage: Pick a theme, then tune how the site looks and feels.
description.description: The line under the appearance dialog's title.

themes.description: The heading over the list of themes in the appearance dialog.

search.description: The placeholder of the field that filters the list of themes.
